description: This file implements the AdbConfigFlag class, which manages command-line flags related to ADB (Android Debug Bridge) configuration within the cuttlefish project. It defines flag handling, processing, and XML help output for ADB connection modes and options.

classes.name: AdbConfigFlagImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the AdbConfigFlag interface, handling command-line flags for ADB configuration, including mode setting and processing.

methods.name: AdbConfigFlagImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the flag with help text and getter/setter logic for the adb_mode flag.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the flag implementation.

methods.name: Dependencies
methods.description: Returns dependencies for the flag feature.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes command-line arguments to set ADB modes and connection options.

methods.name: WriteGflagsCompatHelpXml
methods.description: Outputs help information for the flags in XML format.
